high_level_description: The image shows a close-up of a passport page with an entry stamp from the United Arab Emirates (UAE). The passport is open to a page that has a grid layout typically used for visa stamps or entry/exit records. A hand is pointing at the UAE entry stamp, which includes the date "25 APR 2014" and a code "06075." The stamp also features the UAE flag and some Arabic script. The passport itself appears to be a standard Indian passport, as indicated by the visible text on the top right corner, which includes "भारत" (Bharat)
